## Nvidia's founder steps down

Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's president, chief executive officer and director on November 12, 2026, effective immediately.[^1]
Chief financial officer Colette Kress is interim CEO until the board names a permanent successor.[^1]
Nvidia gave no reason, while CNN and other outlets linked the exit to earlier reports that a woman close to Huang was allegedly working for China.[^7]
The full story is in [[post:2026-11-12-nvidia-ceo-transition]].

## Google's model that decides instead of writing

Google launched the Gemini Decisions API and its Gemini Decision 1 model on November 11, 2026.[^2]
The model returns probabilities for yes/no, multiple-choice and rubric questions instead of generating text.[^2]
It costs $0.10 per million input tokens, and output tokens are free.[^2]
Our story on the launch, with what the coverage got wrong, is [[post:2026-11-13-google-gemini-decision-1]].

## Anthropic prices its listing

An updated filing showed on November 10, 2026 that Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each on Nasdaq, which could raise up to about $64.4 billion.[^3]
Nvidia, Google and other partners agreed to buy $26 billion of stock in a private placement alongside the offering, Decrypt reported.[^3]
The company expects to price the shares on November 18, 2026 and start trading the next day, according to CNBC as cited by Decrypt.[^3]

## Gemini 4 Carbon opens to paying developers

Two weeks after a limited release to cybersecurity defenders, Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to paying developers and businesses on November 10, 2026.[^4]
Digital Trends reports that it ranked first on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR and Zapier's AutomationBench.[^4]
At its introductory rate it costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.[^4]

## Decision models become a category

Microsoft put Microsoft-Decision-1 in public preview in October 2026, describing a model for "fast, structured choices among predefined options".[^6]
OpenAI released its Decisions API in beta on October 6, 2026 and made it generally available on October 22, 2026.[^5]
With Google's entry, three of the largest AI providers now sell models that score answers rather than write them.[^2][^5][^6]

<!-- watch -->
## What to watch: Nvidia's results on November 17

Nvidia said it will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 results on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, as previously scheduled.[^1]
It will be the first public test for the interim team, two weeks before the GTC conference that runs from November 30 to December 3, 2026.[^7]
Huang had also tentatively agreed to testify before House committees, CNN reported.[^7]

- Google's Gemini Decision 1 scores answers instead of writing them, at $0.10 per million input tokens.[^2]
- Anthropic set its IPO range at $70 to $78 a share, with pricing expected on November 18, 2026.[^3]
